Private Function Read1(ch As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant, i As Long, o As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.ChartType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "type=" & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.ChartGroups.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "groups=" & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.Axes.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "axes=" & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.HasAxis(1, 1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "c1=" & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.HasAxis(2, 1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "v1=" & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.HasAxis(1, 2)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "c2=" & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.HasAxis(2, 2)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "v2=" & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "n=" & v & " "
    Err.Clear
    For i = 1 To ch.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set o = Nothing: Set o = ch.SeriesCollection(i)
        v = "E": v = o.Name: s = s & v & ":"
        v = "E": v = o.ChartType: s = s & v & ":"
        v = "E": v = o.AxisGroup: s = s & v & ":"
        v = "E": v = o.PlotOrder: s = s & v & " "
    Next
    Err.Clear
    Read1 = s
End Function

Private Sub Act1(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, ch As Object, s1 As Object, s2 As Object, s3 As Object, r As Variant)
    Dim t As Object, o As Object, n As Long, text As String
    Select Case which
    Case 60
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: r = s2.InvertIfNegative
    Case 61
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: r = s1.InvertIfNegative
    Case 62
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: Set t = ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: r = t.ChartType & " " & t.AxisGroup & " " & t.PlotOrder & " " & ch.ChartGroups.Count
    Case 63
        s1.ChartType = xlLine: Set t = ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: r = t.ChartType & " " & t.PlotOrder
    Case 64
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: s2.Delete: r = ch.ChartType & " " & ch.ChartGroups.Count
    Case 65
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: s1.Delete: r = ch.ChartType & " " & ch.ChartGroups.Count
    Case 66
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: s1.Delete: s3.Delete: r = ch.ChartType & " " & ch.ChartGroups.Count
    Case 67
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): r = ch.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType
    Case 68
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4"): r = ch.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & ch.ChartType
    Case 69
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: ch.ApplyLayout 1: r = ch.ChartGroups.Count
    Case 70
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: ch.ClearToMatchStyle: r = s2.ChartType
    Case 71
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: ch.ChartStyle = 5: r = ch.ChartStyle
    Case 72
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: r = ch.ChartGroups(1).SeriesCollection.Count & " " & ch.ChartGroups(2).SeriesCollection.Count & " " & ch.ChartGroups(1).SeriesCollection(1).Name & " " & ch.ChartGroups(2).SeriesCollection(1).Name
    Case 73
        s2.ChartType = xlLine: r = TypeName(ch.ChartGroups(3))
    Case 74

    Case 75

    Case 82

    Case 83

    Case 84

    Case 107

    Case 108
        s3.ChartType = xlLine: s3.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: s2.ChartType = xlLine: s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: r = ch.ChartGroups.Count
    Case 109
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: s2.ChartType = xlLine: r = s2.AxisGroup
    Case 110
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: s1.ChartType = xlLine: r = s1.AxisGroup & " " & s2.AxisGroup
    Case 111

    Case 112
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: ch.ChartType = xlLine: r = s2.AxisGroup & " " & ch.HasAxis(xlValue, xlSecondary)

    Case 115
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: s2.Delete: r = ch.ChartGroups.Count & " " & ch.HasAxis(xlValue, xlSecondary)
    Case 116
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): r = ch.SeriesCollection(2).AxisGroup
    Case 117

    Case 118
        ch.ChartType = xlPie: ch.SeriesCollection(1).AxisGroup = xlSecondary: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).AxisGroup
    Case 119
        ch.ChartType = xlPie: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).AxisGroup
    End Select
End Sub

    Case 136

    Case 137

    Case 144

    Case 145
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: ch.HasAxis(xlCategory, xlSecondary) = True: ch.HasAxis(xlValue, xlSecondary) = False: r = ch.HasAxis(xlCategory, xlSecondary)
    Case 146
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: ch.Axes(xlValue, xlSecondary).Delete: r = ch.HasAxis(xlValue, xlSecondary) & " " & s2.AxisGroup
    Case 147
        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: ch.HasAxis(xlValue, xlPrimary) = False: r = ch.HasAxis(xlValue, xlPrimary) & " " & ch.HasAxis(xlValue, xlSecondary)
    Case 148

        s2.AxisGroup = xlSecondary: text = "": For Each o In ch.Axes: text = text & o.Type & "/" & o.AxisGroup & " ": Next: r = text

    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, ch As Object, s1 As Object, s2 As Object, s3 As Object, r As Variant, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost", "Rate")
    ws.Range("A2:D2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4, 1)
    ws.Range("A3:D3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6, 2)
    ws.Range("A4:D4").Value = Array("c", 30, 8, 3)
    Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 48, 360, 216)
    Set ch = co.Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:D4")
    ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Set s1 = ch.SeriesCollection(1): Set s2 = ch.SeriesCollection(2): Set s3 = ch.SeriesCollection(3)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which \ 60
    Case 0: Act0 which, folder, ws, co, ch, s1, s2, s3, r
    Case 1: Act1 which, folder, ws, co, ch, s1, s2, s3, r
    Case 2: Act2 which, folder, ws, co, ch, s1, s2, s3, r
    Case 3: Act3 which, folder, ws, co, ch, s1, s2, s3, r
    Case 4: Act4 which, folder, ws, co, ch, s1, s2, s3, r
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v & "|" & Read1(ws.ChartObjects(1).Chart)
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
